mapper.sql: config_id, barcode_format, barcode_type, content_format, content_example, auto_gen_flag, default_template, enable_flag, del_flag, remark
mapper.select: select from wm_barcode_config where config_id = #{configId} and del_flag = '0'
select from wm_barcode_config where barcode_type = #{barcodeType} and enable_flag = 'Y' and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wm_barcode_config (barcode_format, barcode_type, content_format, content_example, auto_gen_flag, default_template, enable_flag, del_flag, remark) values (#{barcodeFormat}, #{barcodeType}, #{contentFormat}, #{contentExample}, ifnull(#{autoGenFlag}, 'N'), #{defaultTemplate}, ifnull(#{enableFlag}, 'Y'), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wm_barcode_config set barcode_format = #{barcodeFormat}, barcode_type = #{barcodeType}, content_format = #{contentFormat}, content_example = #{contentExample}, auto_gen_flag = #{autoGenFlag}, default_template = #{defaultTemplate}, enable_flag = #{enableFlag}, remark = #{remark} where config_id = #{configId} and del_flag = '0'
